name: Corbion N.V.
summary: Corbion N.V. provides lactic acid and derivatives, food preservation solutions, functional ingredient systems, and algae-derived nutritional ingredients in the Netherlands, the United States, Asia, rest of Americas, the rest of Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates in two segments, Functional Ingredients & Solutions, and Health & Nutrition.
